evals.prompt: Build a tiny status app end-to-end with Shepherd. Use executable acceptance examples and prove the generated acceptance tests detect changed example values before implementation proceeds.
evals.expected_output: Shepherd creates .shepherd spec, standards, plan, and progress artifacts that include normal acceptance and acceptance mutation commands; mutation output has total=1 killed=1 survived=0 errors=0; decision is proceed.

evals.prompt: Run Shepherd on an app whose generated acceptance tests still pass when the Gherkin example value is mutated.
evals.expected_output: Shepherd detects survived > 0, records the mutation path and report, refuses to mark the milestone ready, and routes work back to strengthen the spec, step binding, generated assertion, or implementation.

evals.prompt: Run Shepherd on an app where the acceptance mutator fails in parser, generator, runner, or timeout infrastructure while normal tests still pass.
evals.expected_output: Shepherd classifies the result as mutation infrastructure error, treats normal tests as insufficient, and stops or records explicit accepted scope debt before autonomous continuation.

evals.prompt: Run Shepherd on a feature spec with no useful Examples values or parameters that do not affect behavior.
evals.expected_output: Shepherd identifies that acceptance mutation cannot strongly prove behavior and improves or requests behavior-relevant examples before implementation planning proceeds.
